verdict.rationale: Base44's marketing docs describe an interactive builder where the AI 'shows previews before it touches anything' and a board where founders 'see every page at once' and send instructions to the AI, implying a live, pre-publish preview experience; community anecdotes (comm-2, comm-3) confirm founders can quickly build and see functional apps take shape interactively. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'preview vs. publish' toggle or workflow, so the exact mechanics of previewing before publishing are inferred rather than directly confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit docs on a preview/publish separation, screenshots or hands-on account of the live preview pane, and confirmation that changes are not live until explicit publish.
